title: My Stepdaughter Spent $68K On IVF, Vanished With Twins. So I Garnish Her Pay Each Month
description: After my stepdaughter took my late husband's life insurance money for IVF and disappeared with her twins, I sued for breach of contract and won a $95,000 judgment. Now I garnish $800 a month from her hospital executive salary to fund IVF for low-income women, every check marked 'Family Betrayal Fee.' #RevengeStory #Betrayal #NarratedStory
thumb_text: EVERY CHECK READS FAMILY BETRAYAL FEE
pinned_comment: If a stepdaughter swore she'd care for you, spent $68,000 on IVF, then ghosted you with the twins, would you take her to court and garnish her paycheck? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND THE CONTRACT HIDDEN IN A BOOK OF POETRY
